project.name: PLOT
project.summary: A collaborative sprint-planning canvas where people and WebMCP agents shape, prioritize, and move work together.
project.ai_usage: Browser agents collaborate through 17 WebMCP tools; the planner itself stays deterministic and keeps mutations visible and reviewable.
project.codex_usage: Codex supported implementation, refactoring, Supabase/RLS hardening, UX iteration, tests, Playwright review, native WebMCP checks on the public app, Remotion video production and submission documentation.
